type_en: women's pendant with faceted carnelian in chased silver frame

notes_en: Single composite photo (front+back). Same maker/style as g4-03 but a different pendant (different stone shape and frame).

type_en: men's ring with turquoise cabochon

notes_en: Similar design to g4-04 but a different ring: here the shoulders have engraved grooves and the shank no beading, metal looks warm-toned and the stone is more elongated.
